description:
Client for the Pangolin zero-trust network access platform.

Pangolin is the Windows client of the Pangolin security and networking platform. It provides zero-trust access to private resources, stays in the system tray, and connects to Pangolin Cloud or a self-hosted instance.
What's Changed
- Add option to automatically download and install updates
- Fix tunnel running at startup without the tray icon or UI appearing
- Fix session locking on 403 responses when listing exit nodes
Full Changelog: https://github.com/fosrl/windows-linux/compare/0.15.4...0.16.0
